Name: Spirit Halloween Sign for Abandoned JojaMart
Author: MissHP
Description:
Based on a request over on the StardewModders/mod-ideas GitHub that made me laugh out loud when I saw it, I've created a simple "Spirit Halloween" banner and "Open Soon" /"Opening Soon" sign that overlays the abandoned JojaMart in the Fall. 

Has support for the Vanilla JojaMart, the one from Elle's Town Buildings, and the one from Way Back Pelican Town - selectable in the config. Currently only has a vanilla / Elle compatible palette, but will be extended for compatibility with other recolors in the future - let me know which ones you need!

Downloads.Description: Working on my pixel art! Adjusted the banners to flow a bit more naturally
